title: Build a job scheduler in Go — 4 turns
description: Four-turn job scheduler: turn 1 define job, turn 2 schedule/queue, turn 3 retry on failure, turn 4 metrics and tests.

task_spec.prompt: Implement `Start()` in `scheduler/scheduler.go` — launch `s.workers` goroutines. Each worker should read from `s.jobs` channel, call `job.Fn(s.ctx)`, send a `JobResult` to `s.results`, and increment `s.metrics.Succeeded`. Add each goroutine to `s.wg`. Run `go test ./...`.
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `go test ./...` to see where we stand. Now add retry logic: if `job.Fn` returns an error and `attempts < job.MaxRetries + 1`, retry. Increment `s.metrics.Retried` for each retry. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.

Good. Now handle the final failure case: after all retries exhausted, send a `JobResult{Err: err}` to `s.results` and increment `s.metrics.Failed`. Make sure the drain loop in TestJobFailsAfterMaxRetries works (Stop() closes results after Wait). Run `go test ./...`.
Final push: run `go test ./...` and fix any remaining failures. All 3 tests must pass — successful job, retry logic, and fail-after-max-retries.
success_criteria: Failed jobs are retried up to MaxRetries times
Retried count equals number of extra attempts
Failed count incremented when all retries exhausted
